day_shape: 85 items: CENTCOM says 130 vessels redirected under Iran blockade and third tanker struck near Hormuz, IDF raised to high alert on October 7 third anniversary, Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan activate defense pact over Houthi attacks, Pezeshkian names new defense and oil ministers, heavy IRIB/Defa Press cycle.

threads.label: Hormuz blockade and tanker strikes
threads.summary: CENTCOM said 130 vessels have been redirected under an Iran blockade and a third tanker in two days was struck near the Strait of Hormuz, with Pezeshkian calling US talks 'meaningless.' The Jerusalem Post reported the US warned foreign banks of sanctions over Iran dealings, while JD Vance said nothing conclusive yet linked Iran to the flydubai hijacking.

threads.label: October 7 third anniversary and Gaza alert
threads.summary: Israel marked the third anniversary of the October 7 attack with flags at half-staff, and Defense Minister Israel Katz ordered the IDF onto heightened alert in Gaza, citing intelligence Hamas may attempt attacks on troops. The IDF said it dismantled a 1.5 km tunnel in northern Gaza, while Defa Press carried Hamas and IRGC-linked figures praising the 'Al-Aqsa Flood' operation.

threads.label: Yemen front and Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan pact
threads.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan activated collective deterrence measures Monday agreeing to rapidly deploy forces to the kingdom after Houthi attacks, while Saudi-backed Yemeni forces reversed Houthi gains at Bab al-Mandab and two Saudi airports were targeted. Defa Press and IRIB claimed Yemeni forces struck Jeddah refineries and Aramco facilities.

threads.label: Pezeshkian cabinet reshuffle
threads.summary: Pezeshkian nominated missile-industry veteran Mehrdad Akhlaghi Ketabchi as defense minister, filling the post vacant since Aziz Nasirzadeh was killed in US-Israeli strikes in February, and Hamid Bord was introduced as acting oil minister. Iran International reported the outgoing oil minister left as exports fell sharply with disputes over sanctioned crude sales.

threads.label: Iranian defence posture messaging
threads.summary: Defence ministry spokesman Sardar Talaei-Nik claimed weapons production has tripled and vowed a 'heavier' response to any new aggression, while army commander Hatami praised the domestic defence industry. Defa Press said an IRGC ground forces team arrived in Belarus for an SCO counter-terrorism exercise.

threads.label: IRGC oil network and family ties exposed
threads.summary: Iran International reported senior IRGC commander Hossein-Reza Sadeghi and his son played central roles in shifting an IRGC Intelligence oil-sales network's financial operations from the UAE to Russia. A separate report said the Minab school hit in February was founded by the wife of IRGC commander Ali Fadavi.

threads.label: Domestic repression and executions
threads.summary: Iran International reported a 38-year-old was sentenced to death in Bojnurd over January protests, security forces are raiding slain protesters' bedrooms, and Tehran police warned cafes over live music, DJs and hookah. Hardline cleric Mohammad-Bagher Kharrazi was released on bail after about a month in detention.

events.title: Proposal of Special Measure Prohibiting the Transmittal of Funds Regarding Transactions Involving the A7 Network's Sub-Agents
events.summary: FinCEN is issuing a finding and notice of proposed rulemaking, pursuant to section 9714(a) of the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act (Public Law 116-283), as amended by section 6106(b) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022 (Public Law 117-81), finding transactions involving any company operating outside of the United States that is controlled by the A7 Network, a sanctions evasion and money laundering service with ties to Russia, leveraged by a wide range of illicit actors, including Iran and its terrorist proxies, to be a class of transactions of primary money laundering concern in connection with Russian illicit finance and proposing the imposition of a prohibition on certain transmittals of funds, by any covered financial institution, involving that class of transactions.
